title.zh: Kraken 母公司 Payward 与新加坡海湾银行合作提供 24/7 美元结算
title.en: Kraken parent Payward partners with Singapore Gulf Bank for 24/7 USD settlement

current_state.zh: Kraken parent Payward has partnered with Bahrain-regulated Singapore Gulf Bank to let select institutional clients in Asia and the Gulf settle US dollar transactions instantly 24/7 via the bank's SGB Net clearing network, with Singapore Gulf Bank also gaining access to Kraken Prime liquidity and Payward markets for pricing.
